description: This file defines a React component and utility functions for managing notifications/alerts within a UI, specifically handling different categories such as errors, warnings, info, and success messages using Ant Design's notification system. It includes logic to classify errors and messages, parse error details, and customize notification display configurations.

methods.name: defaultPlacement
methods.description: Returns the default placement position for notifications, which is 'topRight'.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes input into a consistent NotificationConfigResolved object, setting default message if necessary.

methods.name: toIntMaybe
methods.description: Attempts to parse a value into an integer, returning undefined if parsing fails.

methods.name: titleFor
methods.description: Determines a notification title based on error status or message content by matching against predefined error patterns.

methods.name: extractStatus
methods.description: Extracts the status code from different possible structures of backend response objects.

methods.name: extractDescription
methods.description: Retrieves and parses an error message or description from various shapes of input data.

methods.name: looksErrorPayload
methods.description: Checks whether an input looks like an error payload, based on structure or type.

methods.name: classifyGeneralMessage
methods.description: Classifies a general message string into categories like success, info, or warning, for notification display.
